pages.title: Archery XP
pages.text: You gain archery XP by landing hits, headshots, long-range shots, and kills: never from the practice dummy. Each level costs a little more than the last, and XP is never lost on death.

pages.title: Skill Tree
pages.text: Every level grants a point to spend across three branches:$(br)$(li)$(l)Draw$(): faster draw$(li)$(l)Crit$(): chance to crit$(li)$(l)Aim$(): tighter spread, and a longer grace before a flax string starts to shake.

pages.title: Capstones
pages.text: Max a branch and a $(l)capstone$() lights up at its tip. Each costs $(l)10 points$(), and you may own $(l)two of the three$(): at level 50 that spends every point, so the last stretch of levelling becomes a choice.

$(li)$(l)Snap Shot$() (Draw): release just as you reach full draw for no spread and +10% damage.$(li)$(l)Called Shot$() (Crit): headshots always crit.$(li)$(l)Dead Calm$() (Aim): sneak and hold still for a second for no spread, no flax shake, and a deeper scope.
